title: Job definition contract with name, handler, inputSchema, retryPolicy and timeoutMs
asA: developer authoring a job in an applying project
iWant: one shipped job-definition shape owned on TAC-3101-jobs-background-job-definition.interfaces.jobModule.default that the jobs runtime registers at boot on the applied queue consumer
soThat: every job in the project follows one uniform contract without the blueprint prescribing an input-validation library or a handler-callback style

acceptanceCriteria.description: The two toy job-definition modules under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-s3-and-queue/jobs/ (send-welcome-email.mjs and refresh-cache.mjs) each export a plain object matching the shape owned on TAC-3101-jobs-background-job-definition.interfaces.jobModule.default. The jobs runtime under src/jobs-runtime.mjs registers every job by name at boot and dispatches by message.name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shared sample-app fixture with the jobs-runtime wired on top of the in-memory queue seam
acceptanceCriteria.when: the fixture jobs runtime boots and reads the jobs/ directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: both toy job modules load without throwing; the runtime's registry has entries keyed by name whose values match the shape owned on TAC-3101-jobs-background-job-definition.interfaces.jobModule.default; dispatch by message.name calls the matching handler

acceptanceCriteria.description: Malformed job-definition module refused at load. Given a job module in the elicited jobs-directory whose default export is missing one of the fields owned on TAC-3101-jobs-background-job-definition.interfaces.jobModule.default, when registerJobs walks the directory at boot, then it refuses with a named error kind (malformedJobDefinition) naming the missing field and the module path; no job registers into the runtime.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a job module missing one shape field
acceptanceCriteria.when: registerJobs walks the elicited jobs-directory at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: registerJobs refuses with malformedJobDefinition naming the missing field and the module path; no job registers

acceptanceCriteria.description: retryPolicy.maxAttempts above applied queue ceiling refused at load. Given a job-definition module whose retryPolicy.maxAttempts exceeds the applied queue's max-attempts ceiling (Cloudflare Queues caps at 100 per ADR-3003 in the messaging-queue-cloudflare blueprint), when the job-definition loader validates the module against the applied queue's ceiling, then the loader refuses with a named error kind (retryPolicyExceedsQueueCeiling) carrying { requested: <maxAttempts>, ceiling: <queueCap> } and the job does not register on the scheduler; no jobScheduled fires.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a job-definition module with retryPolicy.maxAttempts > applied queue's ceiling
acceptanceCriteria.when: the job-definition loader validates the module against the applied queue
acceptanceCriteria.then: loader refuses with retryPolicyExceedsQueueCeiling carrying { requested, ceiling }; the job does not register; no jobScheduled fires
